title: New match
lost: Your settings for “{name}” will be lost.
name: Match name
asyncHint: Everyone moves when they have time. You are notified when it is your turn.
liveHint: Everyone is online at the same time and moves in turn.
duplicatesHint: Several players or AI opponents may lead the same faction.
aiLocked: Led by {name}; change the AI under “Opponents & players”
worldShapeHint: Continent: one large landmass with bays. Islands: every capital on its own island, with neutral islands in between. Archipelago: many small islands, sea lanes decide. For islands and archipelago the assistant suggests the victory condition “Dominance”.
landHintArchipelago: The land share sets the size of the islands. An archipelago works with 20 to 30 % land; above that the islands grow together, while the capitals stay apart.
landHintIslands: The land share sets the size of the islands; from about 50 % the islands grow together, while the capitals stay apart.
seedHint: The same code with the same settings gives the same world. Share it to play a map again.
inviteLinkHint: Share the link with friends who have no fixed seat. It fills seats of the type “Invitation by link”.
fill: Fill free seats with AI at the start
fillHint: Seats that are still free, open or not accepted are replaced by AI opponents (Normal) at the start.
noFriends: You have no friends yet. Invite players with the invitation link instead.
loadFailed: The setup could not be loaded.
createFailed: The match could not be created.
